records.part: Replacement spreaders for two Port-owned ship-to-shore cranes (XC-40 and XC-41)
records.reason: TraPac crane operators prefer Bromma spreaders because they are lighter and more maneuverable, resulting in superior performance and productivity.

records.part: Existing (old) crane spreaders on Cranes XC-40 and XC-41 designated as surplus and to be disposed/recycled
records.reason: The Port will manage the disposal of the two obsolete spreaders within 30 days of installation of new spreaders.
